meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制Claude的记忆模式,让重要内容按场景自动记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望Claude按场景记住关键信息并提醒你
copy.tagline_en: Create custom memory modes so Claude tracks what matters by scenario
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Claude to remember key details per scenario and remind you

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过提问了解你的工作,设计并安装专属记忆模式(观察类型+概念标签),重启后确认生效;可选设置 Telegram 提醒。
howto.when: 当你想让 claude-mem 记住特定内容、新建或调整模式、添加观察类型/标签,或为某些记忆发 Telegram 通知时触发,即使没说“模式”一词。

say.text: 帮我给 claude-mem 建一个记录客户偏好的模式。
say.note: Claude 会先问你的工作场景,再给分类方案让你确认。

say.text: 给我现在用的模式增加“实验结论”和“生产事故”两个标签。
say.note: 会询问标签匹配规则,并询问是否加 Telegram 提醒。

say.text: 设定当记录“合同风险”概念时给我发 Telegram 提醒。
say.note: 会引导你连接 Telegram,并在保存后发测试消息。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude interviews you about your work, designs and installs a custom memory mode (observation types + concept tags), restarts the worker, and verifies the mode is active; optional Telegram alerts can be set.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, add observation types/tags, or get Telegram notifications for certain memories—even without saying 'mode'.

say_en.text: Help me create a mode for recording client preferences in claude-mem.
say_en.note: Claude asks about your work first, then proposes a taxonomy for approval.

say_en.text: Add 'experiment outcome' and 'production incident' tags to my current mode.
say_en.note: It asks about tag matching rules and whether to add Telegram alerts.

say_en.text: Set up a Telegram alert when the 'contract risk' concept is recorded.
say_en.note: It guides you through connecting Telegram and sends a test message.
